en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3106 - Muawiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding the Mahsur (prevented) who did not bring a sacrificial animal.
Imam (as) said: "He performs his rites and returns."

It was asked: "What if he cannot find a sacrificial animal?"
Imam (as) said: "He should fast."
